Production deployment trigger for Galaxy Viewer distance corrections.

Release branch updates from 2026-10-12:
- Applied guarded provisional distance proposals to 83 NOIRLab, 39 ESO, 11 JWST, 6 Chandra, and 4 Spitzer entries.
- Three ESO entries were already at their proposed corrected values.
- Hubble batch workflow is applying eight identifiable records; three generic 'Galaxies' rows were intentionally excluded because the target object is not identified.
- CSV proposals are marked provisional in each corrected record's evidence metadata; the batch is guarded by exact catalog index and prior distance.

This file exists to trigger the production Pages deployment after the catalog commits.
